page.title: Portal Leads (Direct)
page.body:
Unlock High-Quality Leads with PropertyList

Struggling to find qualified leads for your listings? PropertyList has the solution with Public Portal Leads. Connect with serious buyers and renters actively searching for properties.

What are Portal Leads?

At PropertyList, we generate valuable leads from buyers and tenants browsing our portal. Our extensive advertising efforts ensure your properties receive maximum exposure, delivering the best direct leads possible.

The Pay-Per-Enquiry Advantage

With our pay-per-enquiry model, when a lead comes in, you will see the request without contact information. If you decide to purchase the lead using your credits, the contact information will be revealed. This ensures you only connect with motivated individuals, eliminating wasted costs.

Meticulously Screened Leads

We ensure the leads you receive are relevant and qualified, saving you time on filtering through irrelevant enquiries and allowing you to focus on serious prospects. Additionally, if you receive an “agent” lead, your credits will be promptly returned.

How to Leverage Portal Leads

- Optimise Your Listings: Craft compelling headlines, detailed descriptions, and high-quality photos. Use smart keywords to help property seekers find what they’re looking for.

- Respond Promptly: Quickly respond to enquiries to keep leads engaged. We recommend responding within 48 hours. If the lead is rejected or not opened within 72h, it will be redirected to a duplicate property for the best user experience.

- Professional Communication: Be prompt, courteous, and informative in your responses to foster trust.

Easy Management of Portal Leads

All leads are delivered to the dedicated “PORTAL LEADS” tab in your account. You can:

  • Easily Access and Review Leads: View all incoming leads in one location.
  • Effortless Lead Assignment: Assign leads to team members for efficient follow-up.
  • Automated Contact Creation: Each lead is converted into a contact, linked with their enquiry for easy management

Benefits of Portal Leads 

Targeted Audience: Connect with direct buyers and renters actively searching for properties.

Cost-Effective: Only pay for leads who express genuine interest.

Qualified Leads: Benefit from our screening process for relevant inquiries.

Increased Lead Generation: Expand your reach and connect with more potential clients.

Ready to start generating leads with PropertyList.es Sign up today and unlock the power of our Portal Leads program!
